run_litre_cli: run the litre CLI tool to convert ReStructuredText sources into C++ literate programming output
run_litre_dump_mode: run litre with --dump_dir to generate C++ source files using the DumpTranslator
run_litre_workaround_mode: run litre with --workaround flag to use WorkaroundTranslator and apply patches from the dump directory
run_litre_cleanup_source: run litre with --cleanup_source to disable line hashing during source generation
run_litre_bjam_options: run litre with --bjam to pass custom bjam build options to the configuration
